projection.basis: The Cathedral's pinned 1920 by 1357 official JPEG is the unwarped orthographic parent image; the floor uses its byte-identical lossless PDF registration copy.

transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: Official Cathedral JPEG raw bytes are pinned as the primary source. The registered PDF embeds those exact bytes at identity scale. All neutral ink through RGB 250 with chroma <= 16 is retained and the red callouts are rejected. The nave/apse/chapel and cloister faces are reproducibly traced from two locked white connected components of the masked source; the choir, presbytery and courtyard remain source-defined holes. Only source holes of at least 20 pixels are serialized to omit isolated one-pixel raster noise. Number selection faces are derived separately from that same free-space raster after a reviewed set of virtual threshold closures. Those cuts are hit-testing boundaries only and never enter features, walls, openings or navigation.
